traj_tests.note: weights 1/3/5 by severity, guards negative; component weight = mean of the absolute test weights (informational; reward.toml sets the channel weights).

rubric.note: informational; reward.toml sets the channel weights.

pass_rule: a run passes when reward.json reward >= threshold; reward = max(0, 0.5*pytest + 0.5*rubric) (tests/reward/reward.toml); pytest = max(0, (earned - tripped guard weight) / 39), a tripped guard subtracting its weight; rubric = max(0, sum(satisfied source_weight) / 42) with penalties signed; with no judge the rubric is dropped and reward = pytest.
guard_polarity_note: each test_negative_weight_* returns/asserts true when it DETECTS the violation, so a guard is charged when its test passes.
